explanation.explanation: Axes show flow-cytometric fluorescence intensity for marker/antibody channels (e.g., SOX17-Tom, NKX2-5-GFP, PDGFRα-BV421). These are conventionally reported as arbitrary fluorescence intensity without a numerical unit, so no unit is required.
Same as x-axis: fluorescence intensity for the paired marker/antibody channel (e.g., CD235-APC, PDGFRα-BV421, SOX17-Tom) is conventionally unitless/arbitrary in flow cytometry plots.
